svg.title: Ball screw assembly – section
svg.text: Ball screw assembly BS-3210-1000-C5 + BN-3210-FL – longitudinal section (axial scale 1 : 1.4, diameters × 2.4)
flanged ball nut (7) DIN 69051-5 form B style
AC servo motor ≈ 3 kW, rated 3 000 rpm
Machine base (supports in line with guides)
Lead Ph = 10 mm, 1 start, right hand, lead angle 5.51°
Ball Dw 6.35, dpw 33.0, root dr 26.4 mm
Ca = 38 kN, C0a = 76 kN (4 circuits × 1 turn)
Nut rigidity ≈ 670 N/µm, bearing pair 750 N/µm
Grade C5: e_p ± 35 µm, v_up 25 µm (l_u 700 mm)
Fixed side takes ALL axial load; floating side
